name: Freenove ESP32-S3 Display 2.8" IPS (FNK0104B)
description: Modello 3D parametrico 100% manifold (watertight, eps = 0.05 mm) della scheda Freenove ESP32-S3 Display 2.8" IPS (FNK0104B). Include display ILI9341V con touch capacitivo FT6336G, modulo ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8, porta USB-C incavata, slot MicroSD push-push, codec audio ES8311 + NS4150B, LED RGB WS2812 (GPIO 42), pulsanti RST/BOOT e connettori JST 1.25mm 4-pin (UART, Expanded IO, I2C).
hardwareNotes: Display SPI2: MOSI=11, MISO=13, SCLK=12, CS=10, DC=46, BL=45. Touch I2C (0x38): SDA=16, SCL=15, INT=17, RST=18. Connettore UART 4-Pin (5V, GND, TX=GPIO43, RX=GPIO44 consigliato per trigger relè senza click al boot). Connettore Expanded IO 4-Pin (GPIO 2, 3, 14, 21). Audio ES8311 I2S (GPIO 4..8, Amp Enable=GPIO 1).
